description: On-chain spending-policy enforcement for AI agent wallets on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.30). An owner initialises a policy PDA for an agent; check_spend enforces a rolling window budget; the owner can pause or close the policy.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/oculus-program fork. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (init_policy, check_spend, pause_agent, close_policy)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/oculus/
QA: devnet proof of init_policy, check_spend, over-limit and paused rejections, pause_agent and close_policy
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Add a devnet fixture that waits for window_seconds to elapse and confirms spent_window resets inside check_spend
